scenes.title: Invisible Force
scenes.text: Electricity moves through wires at close to the speed of light, lighting your home the instant you flip a switch.

scenes.title: First Battery
scenes.text: The first real battery was invented around eighteen hundred, and it changed the world in ways nobody expected.

scenes.title: You Are Wired
scenes.text: Your nerves run on electricity too, sending signals through your body faster than you can blink.

scenes.title: Living Battery
scenes.text: The electric eel can deliver a shock of several hundred volts, stunning prey with its own body.

scenes.title: Tiny Shocks
scenes.text: That small shock from a doorknob is static electricity, built up by your feet rubbing against the floor.

scenes.title: Hidden Network
scenes.text: A vast invisible grid carries power across whole countries, balancing supply and demand every second of the day.

scenes.title: Clean Power
scenes.text: The future runs on cleaner electricity from sun and wind, stored in batteries that keep getting cheaper.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Modern life would stop without this invisible force. What is one thing you could not live without?
